info.title: Basis API
info.description:
Basis cost segregation API.

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` route needs `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`.
A user is created on first sight, in no organization: firms are invite-only.
`GET /v1/me` lists your firms and the invitations waiting for your verified email; until
you accept one, the study list and study creation answer 403 `no-firm`.

**Authorization.** Studies belong to organizations (firms). A study or firm you are not a
member of is 404, not 403; one you can see but whose action needs a higher role
(viewer < engineer < owner) is 403. Owners administer their firm under
`/v1/orgs/{org_id}`: members, roles and invitations.

**Idempotency.** `POST` and `DELETE` need an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID is
recommended). Retrying with the same key and body replays the stored response with
`Idempotent-Replayed: true` for 24 hours; the same key with a different body is 422; a
retry while the first request is still running is 409. Keys are scoped per user.

**Rate limits.** Per user, by default 240 reads and 60 mutations per minute; 429 with
`Retry-After`.

**Errors.** Every 4xx/5xx is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457): `type`, `title`,
`status`, `detail`, `instance`, `request_id` (equal to the `X-Request-Id` response
header), and `errors` (one entry per field) on validation failures.

**Limits.** JSON bodies up to 1 MiB (413 beyond). Files are never sent to the API: request
a signed URL, upload to it, then confirm.

post.summary: Approve or reject the current review stage
post.description: Records the decision and queues it for the workflow (202). A stage the study is not at, or a revision that is not its current one, is 409; so is a gate the workflow has not opened yet (`gate-not-open`: the study is at the stage but `processing` or `failed`). Each correction's `entity_type` must be one the stage accepts (appraisal_review: extraction_field; rooms_review: room, photo_room; components_review: component, room_component, photo; assets_review: asset; a study whose `components_gate` is false has the single rooms_review: room, component, room_component, photo) and its `entity_id` must exist in the study at the decided revision (a photo or photo_room: a photo document of the study; a room_component: the room it adds a component to); a `photo_room` `after` is exactly a `room_id` of that revision; a `component` `count` must be a whole number from 1, and a `room_component` `after` a taxonomy `label` with a `count` (optional `material`, `attachment` from their vocabularies); otherwise 422 with one `errors` entry per offending correction, located at `["body", "corrections", <index>, "entity_type" | "entity_id" | "after"]`.

post.summary: Add an engineer's selection (a box, a tap or a candidate) at the components review
post.description: A `box` resolves to the stored instance of its label it overlaps at IoU >= 0.5; with none, SAM 3 is prompted with the label's phrases and the box and the instance overlapping the box best at IoU >= 0.5 with score >= 0.5 is stored with its outline (`mask_source: sam_box_prompt`), else the box alone (`none`, `mask_reason` says why; a failed or timed-out call never fails the add). A tap (`point`) resolves to the stored instance under it, 422 when there is none (draw a box). A `candidate` names a stored instance by id. An uncounted candidate becomes a manual instance with its outline (201, `mask_source: candidate`). A selection that is, or covers at intersection over the smaller >= 0.5, a counted instance of its label adds nothing (200, `created: false`, `duplicate_of`) unless `allow_duplicate`. Only while the study waits at `components_review` (`rooms_review` when its `components_gate` is false), on its current revision, once the photo's localization is recorded (409 otherwise; `localization-pending` while SAM 3 still runs).

post.description: No email is sent (`delivery` is `not_sent`): the invitee sees the invitation in `GET /v1/me` once signed in with that email, verified. 409 `already-member` when a member has the email; 409 `invitation-pending` while a pending invitation for it exists (revoke it to change the role). An expired, revoked or declined invitation does not block a new one.

post.description: Signed in with the invited email, verified. 404 when the invitation does not exist or is addressed to another email (the two are indistinguishable); 403 `email-unverified` when your sign-in does not verify the invited email; 409 `invitation-expired`, `invitation-revoked`, `invitation-declined` or `invitation-accepted` once it cannot be answered. filename.title: Filename
filename.description: File name (not a path). Stored NFC-normalized, trimmed, and shortened to 255 UTF-8 bytes if longer.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes (stored lowercase).

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: `application/pdf`, or a UAD 3.6 delivery: its ZIP (`application/zip`) or its MISMO 3.6 XML (`application/xml`, `text/xml`); the extraction recognizes the bytes, not this label.

review_reasons.title: Review Reasons
review_reasons.description: Why it needs review, one reason per item.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

x1.title: X1

y1.title: Y1
y1.description: Top edge, 0 to 1 of the image height.

allow_duplicate.title: Allow Duplicate

CancelRequested.description: 202: the cancel signal was delivered; the workflow records the outcome itself.

candidate_id.title: Candidate Id
candidate_id.description: An active instance of the photo at the current revision (from `GET`); an uncounted candidate is promoted with its mask and label.

verified.title: Verified

doc_id.title: Doc Id

before.title: Before
before.description: The values before the correction, as the reviewer saw them.

unit_cost.title: Unit Cost
unit_cost.description: Null when no cost row priced it.

current_stage.description: The study's stage after the decision.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The study's revision after the decision.

DecisionAccepted.description: 202: the decision is recorded and the workflow signal is queued (outbox).

examples.comment: Year built corrected from the deed.

uploaded_at.title: Uploaded At
uploaded_at.description: Null until the upload is confirmed.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The revision these assets belong to.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page (same revision); null on the last.

role.title: Role
role.description: `source`: the photo the component was found in; `room`: another photo of the same room.

localization_status.title: Localization Status
localization_status.description: The photo's localization outcome at this revision, if it ran.

instances.title: Instances
instances.description: Active localized instances of the component's label in this photo.

id.title: Id
id.description: The field's id (the `entity_id` of an `extraction_field` correction).

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The appraisal document it was read from.

label.title: Label
label.description: The caption printed on the form, when catalogued.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: The catalogue marks the field critical.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Where the value is printed, to highlight on the PDF (docs/api/FIELD_REGIONS.md): boxes on `page` as page fractions, origin top-left. Empty when the value was not located (then fall back to searching the page's text).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

page.title: Page
page.description: The 1-based PDF page the box is on.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` as fractions of the page's width and height (0..1), origin top-left: multiply by the rendered page's size in pixels to draw it.

checks.description: Dependency checks; absent when none is configured.

db.description: Absent when no database is set.

temporal.description: Absent when Temporal is not configured. A failure here does not make the answer 503 (decisions are queued in the outbox while Temporal is down).

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The photo a per-photo row was found in; null for a reconciled row.

seen_in.title: Seen In
seen_in.description: The photos a reconciled object was seen in (empty for a per-photo row).

added.title: Added
added.description: An engineer added it to the room at a rooms review (a `room_component` correction); its asset is built whatever the room's inventory.

membership.description: After accepting: your membership in the firm (an existing higher role is kept). Null after declining, or if you were removed after accepting.

email.title: Email
email.description: The invitee's email. Trimmed and lower-cased; the invitee must sign in with this address, verified, to accept.

role.description: `owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).
`owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).

invited_by_name.title: Invited By Name
invited_by_name.description: Who sent it; null (with `invited_by_email`) when Basis set the firm up.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: No email is sent. The invitee sees the invitation when they sign in with the invited email.

InvitationOut.title: InvitationOut
InvitationOut.description: An invitation as the firm's owners see it.

role.description: `owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).

invited_by_name.title: Invited By Name
invited_by_name.description: Who sent it; null (with `invited_by_email`) when Basis set the firm up.

InviteeInvitationOut.title: InviteeInvitationOut
InviteeInvitationOut.description: An invitation as its invitee sees it.

object.description: The new manual instance, or (`created: false`) the counted instance that already covers the selection.

created.title: Created
created.description: False when the selection is an instance already counted (nothing was added): `duplicate_of` names it.

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of
duplicate_of.description: When nothing was added: the counted instance the selection duplicates (the `object` returned). Send the selection again with `allow_duplicate: true` to add it anyway.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: When nothing was added: how much the selection covers that instance (intersection over the smaller of the two outlines, or of the boxes); 1 when the selection resolved to that instance itself.

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Run lengths over the row-major flattened mask, zeros first.

email_verified.title: Email Verified
email_verified.description: Whether your sign-in confirms your email. Invitations are listed and can be answered only when it does (Google sign-in confirms it).

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.description: Your firms, by name. Empty: you are not a member of any firm yet.

pending_invitations.title: Pending Invitations
pending_invitations.description: Pending invitations to your verified email, newest first; empty while `email_verified` is false.

role.description: `owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).
`owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).

OrgRole.title: OrgRole
OrgRole.description: ``org_members.role`` (TEXT with a CHECK, not a PostgreSQL enum).

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: File name (not a path). Stored NFC-normalized, trimmed, and shortened to 255 UTF-8 bytes if longer.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes (stored lowercase).

phrase.title: Phrase
phrase.description: The phrase SAM 3 was prompted with (model rows).

score.title: Score
score.description: SAM 3's score; null for a manual box.

area.title: Area
area.description: Share of the image the instance covers.

counted.title: Counted
counted.description: Counted in `counts`: a model instance whose score clears its class's threshold, or any manual instance. Uncounted model instances are candidates.

derived_from.title: Derived From
derived_from.description: For a manual instance: the candidate the tap or box resolved to.

mask_source.title: Mask Source
mask_source.description: Where a manual instance's outline came from: `candidate` (a stored candidate SAM 3 found), `sam_box_prompt` (SAM 3 prompted with the engineer's box) or `none` (the box alone). Null for model instances.

mask_reason.title: Mask Reason
mask_reason.description: Why a manual instance has no outline (`mask_source` is `none`): nothing matched the box, the call failed or timed out, or no localizer.

localization.description: The localization outcome; null when the photo has not been localized at this revision (not analyzed yet, or analyzed before localization existed).

items.title: Items
items.description: Active instances by label, highest score first, manual boxes last.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: File name (not a path). Stored NFC-normalized, trimmed, and shortened to 255 UTF-8 bytes if longer.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes (stored lowercase).

allow_duplicate.title: Allow Duplicate
allow_duplicate.description: Add even when the selection covers a counted instance of its label (after a `created: false` answer naming it in `duplicate_of`).

already_requested.title: Already Requested
already_requested.description: A retry was already accepted and the stage has not restarted yet.

RetryRequested.title: RetryRequested
RetryRequested.description: 202: the workflow accepted the retry and runs the failed stage again.

role.description: `owner` (the firm's admin: members, invitations, every study), `engineer` (creates and reviews studies) or `viewer` (reads studies).

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The file-name room id the room groups (null: grouped by the model's room identity).

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: The room's photos, in file-name order.

inventory_source.title: Inventory Source
inventory_source.description: `room_inventory`: one reconciled row per object of the room; `per_photo`: the per-photo rows (no reconciliation for this room).

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: The room step flagged the room's inventory.

suggested_counts.title: Suggested Counts
suggested_counts.description: Per label with counted instances on the room's photos, by label.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

url.title: Url
url.description: Send the file here with `method` and exactly `headers`.

property_name.title: Property Name
property_name.description: Property name or address shown to reviewers (one line; trimmed).

org_id.title: Org Id
org_id.description: Organization that will own the study. Optional when the caller can create studies (engineer or owner) in exactly one organization.

room_aliases.title: Room Aliases
room_aliases.description: Rooms to merge when photos are grouped by file name: `{room id: room id}`, where a room id is the photo file name's room (`1_kitchen` for "21_1st Floor Kitchen photo 1.JPG", `b_bath` for "Basement Bath.JPG", `x_mechanicals` for "Mechanicals.JPG"). `{"1_breakfast_nook": "1_kitchen"}` puts the breakfast nook's photos in the kitchen. Chains are followed; a loop (including a room aliased to itself) is a 422 validation problem. Rooms can also be merged at the rooms review (a `room` correction with `merge_into`).

room_aliases.title: Room Aliases
room_aliases.description: The study's room aliases (`{room id: room id}`): those given at creation and the merges made at the rooms review.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the current stage failed, while `status` is `failed` (retry with `POST /v1/studies/{id}/retry`).

components_gate.title: Components Gate
components_gate.description: Whether the study's workflow reviews the components after the rooms (`rooms_review` takes the grouping, `components_review` the components and counts); false for a study with the single rooms review (started before it); null until the workflow starts.

latest_reviews.title: Latest Reviews
latest_reviews.description: For each review stage decided so far, the decision with the highest revision.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

room_aliases.title: Room Aliases
room_aliases.description: The study's room aliases (`{room id: room id}`): those given at creation and the merges made at the rooms review.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the current stage failed, while `status` is `failed` (retry with `POST /v1/studies/{id}/retry`).

components_gate.title: Components Gate
components_gate.description: Whether the study's workflow reviews the components after the rooms (`rooms_review` takes the grouping, `components_review` the components and counts); false for a study with the single rooms review (started before it); null until the workflow starts.

status.description: The workflow's `status` query; null when it could not answer (for example while no worker is running).

inventory_count.title: Inventory Count
inventory_count.description: The label's count in the room's inventory now (the rows its assets are built from).

photo_count.title: Photo Count
photo_count.description: The most counted instances of the label in one photo of the room: SAM 3's counted instances plus the engineers' manual ones.

suggested.title: Suggested
suggested.description: max(`inventory_count`, `photo_count`): a room has at least as many as one photo shows. A suggestion for the engineer to confirm with a `component` (`count`) or `room_component` correction; nothing changes by itself.

UploadTicket.title: UploadTicket
UploadTicket.description: 201: the document is registered; upload the bytes, then call `.../complete`.

waiting_since.title: Waiting Since
waiting_since.description: When the current review wait began.

decisions_applied.title: Decisions Applied
decisions_applied.description: Review ids the workflow has applied.

awaiting.title: Awaiting
awaiting.description: The review gate the workflow is waiting at; decisions are accepted only here.

flagged_photos.title: Flagged Photos
flagged_photos.description: Photo document ids whose analysis failed permanently, hit the budget, or was flagged.

needs_review_stages.title: Needs Review Stages
needs_review_stages.description: Stages whose output needs an engineer's attention because the budget ran out.

failed_stage.description: The stage that failed, while the workflow waits for `POST /v1/studies/{id}/retry`; null otherwise.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The Temporal run id of the study's execution.

WorkflowStarted.title: WorkflowStarted
WorkflowStarted.description: 202: the study's workflow is running (or ran); the same answer on every repeat.
